description: Turn any oven recipe into air fryer settings: 25F lower, about 20 percent less time, and a check-at time so nothing overcooks. Pick your food and convert.
intro: Nearly every recipe on the internet is written for the oven, and the air fryer cooks hotter and faster than the oven does. The conversion is two small moves: take 25F off the temperature, and take 20 percent off the time. A recipe that bakes at 425F for 25 minutes becomes 400F for 20 minutes in the air fryer, and you start checking at 18 minutes.

Some guides change only the temperature and keep the full oven time. This converter applies both adjustments, the combined rule most conversion guides publish, and gives you a check-at time so nothing overcooks. The converted numbers are a starting point, not a promise. The thermometer decides when meat is done, and your eyes decide when everything else is.

Each converter below is for one food, with its own typical oven settings, its own presets, and its own table. Pick the food in your recipe, type in the oven settings, and the answer updates as you type. Start with the dish you cook most, and the rest follows.
metaDescription: Convert oven temperature and time to air fryer settings: 25F lower and about 20 percent less time, with a check-at time and food presets for every dish.
